name: Sparkle Gold Rock Limited
about: Sparkle Gold Rock Limited engages in the sales and purchase of bullion, gems, jewellery, metals jewelry in India. The company trades in gold, silver, diamond jewelry, gemstones, and other accessories. It also involves in exploring and mining of gold, silver, iron, coal, and copper, as well as trading of stones, marble, granite, and artificial marble. In addition, the company manufactures, repairs, alters, and deals in machinery required for mining operations. The company was formerly known as Sree Jayalakshmi Autospin Limited and changed its name to Sparkle Gold Rock Limited in April 2025. Sparkle Gold Rock Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Jaipur, India.
